deploybot: Build #4592 started for staging — commit a1b2c3d (release/2026-03-20-staging) • triggered by @Alice
ci-bot: pipeline steps: lint -> test:unit -> build -> smoke -> deploy
deploybot: Build #4592: lint failed (step: eslint) — summary below
```
ERROR src/runtime/kv_cache.ts:42:9 - 'no-unused-vars'
  40 | import { Logger } from '../logger';
  41 | 
> 42 | const UNUSED = true;
     |         ^^^^
  43 |
  44 | export function evict() { ... }
```
Alice: saw it, on it. looks like an accidental leftover constant from last refactor. I'll push a one-line fix.
Ben: heads-up — this surfaced after the codegen package bumped precommit hooks. might need to pin codegen package to avoid other style drift.
Carla: change window still open until 18:00 PT. how long for the fix? :clock1: 
Dave: I can repro locally with `yarn lint`. quick patch ready (remove UNUSED). will run prettier before pushing.
release-manager: surface risk: unit tests have been flaky on the encoder suite lately. if this is just lint, fastpatch + rerun CI is fine. if unit tests blow up, prefer pin -> rerun rather than rolling forward.
Alice: pushed PR #789 -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/789 — removes UNUSED const and runs format.
deploybot: Rebuild triggered by Alice (PR #789) — Build #4593 started
ci-bot: Build #4593 status: lint ✓, unit tests ✗ (2 failing), build step pending
Ben: unit failures look like encoder kv-cache eviction timeout, likely flaky on GPU runner. logs: 
```
 FAIL tests/encoder/kv_eviction.test.ts (10.3s)
   ● kv eviction › evicts oldest keys under pressure

     Timeout - Async callback was not invoked within the 10000ms timeout specified by jest.setTimeout.

     at onTimeout (node:internal/timers:564:14)
```
Dave: suggestion — quarantine the failing test (label @flaky) + re-run CI. If only flaky unit tests remain, we can proceed with a staging canary with feature flag `kv_eviction_stress` off.
release-manager: decision: do NOT roll forward to prod. Action plan: 1) pin codegen to 1.4.2 in package lock, 2) backport lint fix (PR #789), 3) quarantine flaky encoder test, 4) rerun CI. If all green, perform canary in staging at 10% traffic with smoke tests. If smoke green, continue rollout; else rollback to tag release/2026-03-19-stable.
Alice: pinned codegen@1.4.2 in yarn.lock and pushed commit (PR #790). Requeueing build.
deploybot: Build #4596 queued (after pin + backport) — triggering CI
ci-bot: Build #4596: all checks passed ✓ — lint ✓, unit tests ✓ (flaky test quarantined), build ✓
deploybot: Staging deploy scheduled in 30 minutes (canary mode). Rollout paused pending smoke tests.
Carla: I'll run smoke tests in ~10m and report. :eyes: 
release-manager: I'll monitor metrics and error budgets during canary. rollback plan ready: revert to release/2026-03-19-stable and notify customers if we see regressions.
Erin: adding release note draft: "Fix lint regression originating from codegen precommit bump; pin codegen to 1.4.2; quarantined flaky encoder tests while we investigate."
Alice: thanks team — will watch the smoke run and be on standby for a quick hotfix if needed. :raised_hands:
